name: obsidian-literature
description: Focused paper reading and structured literature analysis

interface.shortDescription: Read papers and build structured Obsidian analyses
interface.longDescription: Read, locate, compare, review, and learn from Zotero papers, then safely write typed analyses and one Analysis Base in an Obsidian vault.
defaultPrompt: Explain one Zotero paper at the depth I request.
Compare selected papers on my stated dimensions.
Build a structured literature review or concept note.
